acceptanceCriteria: Baseline and candidate use identical scenarios and environment; duplicate call counters decrease or candidate is rejected.
Governance decisions, errors, evidence bindings, exit codes, and deterministic summaries remain identical.
Fresh facts are not shared across file modifications or protected-operation boundaries.
All required evidence, verification commands, and raw measurements are retained.
Runtime-generated lifecycle records remain repository-bound and append-only.
Required verification evidence is represented by the Runtime's verification class.
goal: Measure and, only when supported by evidence, eliminate duplicate repository discovery, Runtime identity, Git snapshot, configuration/evidence parsing, file read/hash, status/outcome/doctor fact collection.
intent: Reduce request-path latency and resource cost by reusing immutable facts within one observation cycle while preserving governance semantics, repository isolation, authorization boundaries, evidence binding, and recovery.
requiredEvidenceClasses: P0 benchmark artifacts and raw samples; call-count and behavior comparison; Runtime preflight/checkpoint/verify/finish/archive/close receipts
